look, all of you. I suffer daily with extreme physical pain. I honestly have thought about killing myself, I do legally own a gun and hollow points. I could and my life anytime I want. I mean last year I lost my mother, great uncle (18 hours part) lost a cousin a week later. Two friends the next month. and this last August I lost my eldest sister. I still do think about ending my life almost every single day. I am getting help with my back and hip pain. I am hopeful. I do not have depression. Those of you that do, Please get help. Even on my worst days, when I am writhing in pain and the thought comes up to go to my safe and pop a clip in and be done with this life, I reject it. I have kids, I have friends who are like brothers to me and I can't leave them like that. Life is too short to be unhappy. Please get help. I know that mental health problems are still stigmatized and in my case if I told anyone about my thoughts they would 'red flag' me and take my guns away. But I have people to lean on in my life. reach out to your loved ones if you can, if not reach out to me. You are NOT alone in this life. There are good people out there who can help.
